gripOrHq.title: Weather-to-Finance Pipe
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, the Corp loses [4].

gripOrHq.title: Terrorist Reprisal
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if the Corp scored any Black Ops agendas during its last turn. The Corp discards five cards at random.

gripOrHq.title: All-Nighter
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run; whether or not that run is successful, you may then make another run.

gripOrHq.title: Hot Tip for WNS
gripOrHq.rulesText: Score 1 agenda point if you liberated any Black Ops agendas this turn.

heapOrArchives.title: Executive Wiretaps
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If successful, access two additional cards from HQ.

heapOrArchives.title: Inside Job
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

heapOrArchives.title: Romp through HQ
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on HQ; you may trash, at no cost, any cards you access that were stored in HQ, even if the cards cannot normally be trashed.

heapOrArchives.title: All-Nighter
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run; whether or not that run is successful, you may then make another run.

scoreArea.title: Bioweapons Engineering
scoreArea.rulesText: Each source of meat damage inflicts +1 meat damage.

scoreArea.title: Marked Accounts
scoreArea.rulesText: When Runner accesses Marked Accounts, give Runner a tag, even if it is not installed. If Marked Accounts is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

rig.title: Pile Driver
rig.rulesText: [3]: Break up to four wall subroutines on a single piece of ice. [1]: +1 strength. Whenever you use Pile Driver’s break-walls subroutine, lose a total of [3] from stealth cards.

ice.title: Nerve Labyrinth
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 2 net damage.
[Subroutine] End the run.

root.title: Scorched Earth
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Do 4 meat damage.

root.title: Manhunt
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner attempted a run during his or her last turn. Trace 6-If trace is successful, give Runner one tag for each point by which your trace exceeded his or her link.

ice.title: Fatal Attractor
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] The next time Runner encounters a piece of ice during the run, do 3 Net damage unless Runner breaks all subroutines of that piece of ice.

root.title: TRAP!
root.rulesText: If you pay [4] when Runner accesses TRAP!, it does 3 Net damage and gives Runner a tag, even if TRAP! is not installed. Ignore this effect if Runner accesses it from the Archives. If TRAP! is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.
